payload.rebuttal: fixed: The three new tests only compared describe(e), which renders label and detail and never reads .phase, so a wrong phase passed silently. I added explicit assert [e.phase for e in events] == ["PACKAGE", "PACKAGE"] and the matching .spec_id assertion to each of the three tests, reading the real PhaseStart objects before stringifying them. I reproduced the phase="REVIEW" mutant and confirmed all three now fail against it.
